summary: Ansible 10 community.general deprecations: apt_rpm state=present/installed will stop upgrading (use latest or present_not_latest), consul_acl is replaced by consul_token and consul_policy, django_manage ack_venv_creation_deprecation, GitLab basic auth, the hipchat callback, and irc use_tls and validate_certs defaults changing to true.
questions: Why does apt_rpm state=present upgrade packages?
Will irc validate_certs default to true?
